evidence.observation: Required exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; atmosphere composition cannot be verified.
Tube pressure was 2.952 Torr at the start of growth.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.159 Torr despite essentially constant temperature and argon flow; the cause and acceptable pressure range are unknown.
Temperature 750.2 C and argon 100.3 sccm track setpoints of 750 C and 100 sccm; controller reports running, but this does not verify atmosphere integrity.

args.missing_evidence: Required exhaust O2 measurement, expected growth-stage pressure limits or normal-run reference, and a pressure/flow or leak-integrity check to distinguish the cause of the pressure rise; sample characterization is not yet available.
